messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to your sister’s bank account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, and I can’t promise where or when the card issuer will show the credit. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

The returned speaker is eligible for a refund of BRL 149.65 to the original payment. (refund-policy/v2/amount) Would you like me to prepare that proposal? If so, you can confirm the exact amount using the button on its proposal card.
